kjv: Her (the woman's) sins, which are many, are forgiven; for she loved much
mine: her (the woman's) sins, which are many, are forgiven—for she loved much
note: hoti can give the ground of the statement (her love shows she has been forgiven, as the parable in 7:41-43 implies) rather than the cause of forgiveness; KJV's wording, like mine, is ambiguous, but has often been read as love earning forgiveness.
